unit: one designated primary invocation within a continuous legal episode

windows.T_post: pure getters after T_tx before mutation

layers.O1: raw return tuple or REVERT from T_tx
layers.O2: O1 + all declared public pre/post getters + public events/status/source/failure fields
layers.O3: O2 + predeclared trace and nonpublic pre/post storage; no public field may be withheld

O2_events: normalized public MainFeedSync/MainFeedFail history from the frozen setup prefix since the prior designated observation

public_history_rule: public setup-prefix events are included in O2 for every layer and do not require another target call; they are not treated as events of the later pure primary read
fathom_noninterference: collector may never call peekPrice except as the single T_tx primary invocation

normalization.revert: symbol plus raw selector/data, never numeric zero
